Name: Hay Collection
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
Basically a simplified / minimized version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1430]Better Hay[/url], which has yet to be updated.

It's not the same mod, and no code from better hay was used.

If your inventory is full, it will drop on the ground for you to collect later

[size=5][b]How to install : [/b][/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder

[url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/Hay Collection][Source Code][/url]

Manifest.Name: Hay Collection
Manifest.Description: Allows you to collect hay, regardless of whether you have silos or not
